top_five.text: A major 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia has killed over 240 people, injured hundreds, and caused widespread collapse of residential structures.
A rapidly expanding Ebola epidemic in East Africa and the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed over 2,000 lives amidst severe healthcare disruptions.
An Israeli strike targeted the Abu Asi orphan camp in Gaza, threatening vulnerable displaced populations and civilian care facilities.
Accelerating mpox transmission in Madagascar has forced health officials to ration and divide scarce vaccine supplies across the country.
Remnants of Typhoon Dolphin triggered severe flooding and mass evacuations of thousands of residents across central and northern China.

top_story.quote: A powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, leaving over 240 people dead, hundreds injured, and emergency teams searching for survivors beneath collapsed infrastructure.
top_story.label: AMERICAS — Colombia Earthquake

Middle East.headline: Occupied Palestinian Territory — Israeli attack reported at Gaza displaced camp
Middle East.body: An Israeli strike reportedly targeted the Abu Asi orphan camp in Gaza, affecting facilities housing displaced people and orphans. Reports indicate that wounded individuals continued providing care for displaced residents following the attack. The strike highlights sustained protection risks to civilians and displaced populations residing in temporary shelters across the Gaza Strip amidst ongoing military hostilities.

Middle East.headline: Yemen — Defense Department probes US military strikes over civilian casualties
Middle East.body: The United States Department of Defense reported that military strikes in Yemen killed 153 civilians last year. According to official statements, 15 individual strikes remain under active investigation. The disclosures highlight severe ongoing protection concerns and civilian harm caused by external military operations within Yemen, where civilian populations continue to face risks from aerial bombardments and armed conflict.

Middle East.headline: Red Sea / Yemen — Maritime attacks cause casualties near Bab al-Mandeb
Middle East.body: Reports indicate an escalation in maritime attacks in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and surrounding regional waters. According to news reports, a Houthi strike targeted a ship in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, with claims of crew casualties ranging from three to six people killed in the incident. Separate reports note additional strikes involving a cargo vessel near the Gulf of Oman resulting in four deaths, amid broader regional conflict escalation and maritime security threats.
verified_figures: 3 to 6 crew killed in Bab al-Mandeb strike

Middle East.headline: Syria — Soldiers killed in attack near Qamishli
Middle East.body: An attack in Qamishli, northeastern Syria, resulted in the deaths of two Syrian army soldiers, according to military statements. Security conditions in northeastern Syria remain fragile as armed groups continue localized attacks, posing potential risks to humanitarian access and civilian safety across Hasakah province.

Americas.headline: Colombia — Major 7.4-magnitude earthquake kills over 240 in western regions
Americas.body: Search and rescue operations are underway in western Colombia following a major 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck on Monday, triggering multiple aftershocks. The disaster caused widespread destruction of homes and apartment buildings across western Colombia, including in Cali. Reporting indicates at least 180 to over 240 people have been killed, with hundreds more injured or missing under collapsed structures. Emergency teams continue searching for survivors trapped beneath rubble, successfully pulling a 32-year-old woman alive from a collapsed building on Tuesday. The event represents one of Colombia's worst earthquakes in decades.

Africa.headline: DR Congo — Escalating Ebola outbreak kills over 2,000 people
Africa.body: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report that a rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak has killed at least 2,011 people and infected 4,381. Officials indicate the outbreak is the fastest-spreading on record and began months before it was officially declared. Response efforts are currently being outpaced by the virus as health workers strike over pay, complicating containment efforts amid high infection rates.

Europe.headline: Russia/Ukraine — Four killed in cross-border overnight attacks
Europe.body: Overnight attacks across southern Russia and Ukraine killed at least four people, according to local officials. In the Russian port city of Novorossiysk, municipal authorities reported that strikes killed a child and damaged dozens of buildings. The casualties and damage follow sustained cross-border bombardments hitting infrastructure and populated areas in both nations.

Europe.headline: Ukraine — North Korean ballistic missiles reported in Zaporizhzhia attack
Europe.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russian forces used North Korean ballistic missiles in a recent deadly attack on Zaporizhzhia. Zelenskyy accused Pyongyang of escalating its military support for Moscow. Kyiv is seeking closer cooperation with international partners, including South Korea, to counter ongoing missile attacks targeting Ukrainian territory.

Asia-Pacific.headline: China — Typhoon Dolphin triggers mass evacuations and torrential rainfall
Asia-Pacific.body: Remnants of Typhoon Dolphin brought severe flooding, torrential rainfall, and landslide risks across central and northern China, forcing the evacuation of thousands of residents from high-risk areas in Beijing. Weather authorities warned the capital could receive over 150 mm of rainfall within 24 hours, with localized areas facing more than 200 mm, exceeding one-third of Beijing's total annual average precipitation. The extreme weather has disrupted transport networks, construction, and regional infrastructure across multiple provinces.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Myanmar — Military escalates airstrikes affecting civilians in flood zones
Asia-Pacific.body: Investigators report that Myanmar's military has escalated airstrikes against civilian targets across the country. In Ayeyarwady Region, an air attack killed two displaced brothers in an area already suffering from major flooding. The escalation poses severe protection risks to displaced communities seeking shelter in disaster-affected zones.

Asia-Pacific.headline: India — Severe flooding expands to previously safe areas in Assam
Asia-Pacific.body: Severe seasonal flooding in Assam State, India, has inundated areas previously considered safe from major rising waters. The expanding flood zones have created severe protection concerns and rescue challenges for elderly and vulnerable residents stranded by fast-moving waters.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: East Africa — Ebola outbreak deaths pass 2,000 in fastest-spreading epidemic on record
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: An Ebola outbreak in East Africa has caused more than 2,000 deaths, making it the fastest-growing epidemic of the virus on record. The disease reportedly spread undetected for several months prior to recognition, severely hampering containment efforts as scientists race to develop a vaccine. To assist with containment and response operations across East Africa, the United States has pledged an additional 31 billion Kenyan shillings in funding.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: Madagascar — Authorities divide mpox vaccine supplies amid accelerating epidemic
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: Madagascar has been forced to divide and share its limited mpox vaccine supplies as an epidemic accelerates across the country. The measure comes as health workers attempt to manage the expanding outbreak amid constraints on vaccine availability and distribution. Further details on case numbers and coverage remain limited as response efforts continue.

escalation_risks.potential_impact: Deterioration of security conditions threatening humanitarian access and civilian safety across Hasakah province.

escalation_risks.trigger: Further military airstrikes targeting flood-affected areas where displaced populations are sheltering.
